messages:
mia: Kicking off v2.13.0 blue/green for api-router. Change window 2025-03-15 02:00 UTC. Changelog: https://git.redwood/repo/router/compare/v2.12...v2.13
mia: Pinning router-version=2.13.0 for green, requesting preflight ack and standby for rollback playbook link.
deploy-bot: @mia deploy scheduled: target=api-router, variant=green, plan=warm->drain->shift, steps=5%->25%->100%, drain=120s, id=deploy-8721
ashley: ACK. I'll watch p95 + error-rate. Suggest disabling cookie stickiness for the cutover to make rollback cleaner.
sam: Recommend initial 5% for 10m, check p95 and 5xx. Rollback if p95 >200ms OR 5xx >1% sustained for 3m. Also watch kv cache hit rates.
len: +1 to stickiness OFF. Add rescue route pinned to router:v2.12 as fallback: `rescue_route: router:v2.12` and set fallback policy to immediate on rollback command.
harper: Added preflight health checks: `/healthz`, `/kv/status`, `/metrics/readiness`. Will run synthetic probes during warm.
ops-bot: Canary monitors created: https://grafana.redwood/d/routers/canary (SLOs + alert rules). Pager escalation if >=5% 5xx across any region for 3m :rotating_light:
nashley: Note: eu-west needs longer LB drain due to long-lived connections. Can we override per-region drain times?
deploy-bot: Per-region drain override applied: eu-west=180s, us-east=90s.
mia: Rollout plan: warm green at 5% for 10m -> probe latency/errors. If OK, bump to 25% for 15m -> manual hold -> 100%. Manual hold before final 100% cut.
sam: If mem growth on green >10% vs blue within 15m, immediate rollback. We'll keep heap and open file metrics on watch.
len: Confirm rescue route remains. Also set circuit-breaker threshold: `cb_err_rate: 1.5%` for auto-failover guard.
harper: Release notes snippet pushed to internal docs: "v2.13: kv-cache optimizations + kernel selection tweak. Expect transient p95 during cache warmup." Link: https://docs.redwood/internal/releases/v2.13
nashley: Preflight load run? `./tools/loadtest --target api-router-green --rps 50 --duration 5m` — want to kick a small run now.
sam: Running short load now, will report in ~3m.
deploy-bot: deploy-stage=warm started at 1758888020. Green instances spin up: image=gcr/redwood/router:2.13.0-rc3, desired=12.
ops-bot: Alert: one green node failing liveness probe in us-east during warmup (last 30s). instance=i-0923. Marking unhealthy and replacing.
len: Removed unhealthy instance from ASG, replacement started. Keeping warm target.
mia: Decision: proceed to 5% steady after stabilization (6m). Rollback condition if 5xx spike >1% or p95 >200ms. Rollback command: `deploy-bot rollback deploy-8721` + route pin revert.
nashley: Confirmed. I'll watch error budget and slo graphs.
sam: Load test stable: p95 +8ms, 0 errors.
deploy-bot: traffic split updated at 1758888060: green=5%, blue=95%.
harper: Tagged release and pinned: `router:v2.13.0 -> release/2025-03-15`. Rollback playbook linked in docs: https://docs.redwood/playbooks/router-rollback
len: Leaving `rescue_route: router:v2.12` in place. If triggered, run `deploy-bot rollback deploy-8721` then `lb-drain cancel` and reroute.
mia: All set. I'll be on standby for the 25% bump. :thumbsup:
